home.title: Regatta Hotel Brisbane | Iconic Riverside Pub Since 1874
home.metaDesc: Discover Brisbane’s historic Regatta Hotel. A riverside pub since 1874, serving great food, cold beer and unforgettable moments on the Brisbane River.
home.text: Skip to: Home Content Footer navigation About Bar & Dining Functions What’s On Melbourne Cup Live Sport Gaming Contact - BOOK THE BOATSHED HOST A FUNCTION Brisbane’s Most Iconic Venue Located on the Brisbane River, the Regatta Hotel has been the place to gather with family, friends, and colleagues since 1874. For over 145 years Brisbane has met, mingled and created memories beyond the iron-laced verandahs of the iconic Regatta Hotel. Home to legendary sporting achievements and one of the first feminist insurgencies, our Grand Lady of the Brisbane River has withstood flood, fire and more than a century of change. Despite her evolution over the years, some things remained the same: her love for a cold beer, a great steak and the people who shared in her history.
